subject: Clearsight: request for API contract & versioning alignment
messages:
From: Alex Park <alex@clearsight.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: API contract / versioning alignment for Clearsight integration

Hi Marissa (and Jonas),

Thanks again for the demo last week — the integration looks promising. Our engineering team ran a quick spike against the current Redwood API and surfaced two things we'd like to align on before we move to a production integration:

1) Version lock/compat guarantees: we rely on a stable API contract for embeddings and metadata fields. Can Redwood provide a clear deprecation policy for breaking changes and a guaranteed grace period for major version bumps?

2) SDK behaviour: our SDK (used by customers) currently relies on certain response fields and the current JSON schema. We need to know whether Redwood will publish a semver-like compatibility table and whether there will be adapter shims for at least one major prior version.

Attached a short compatibility matrix from our spike. High-level ask: a written alignment on roadmap timing + a proposed timeline for deprecation (if any) so we can plan our release cadence.

Can we get a written proposal by EOD Friday (US)? If not, a short meeting to sync next week works.

Best,
Alex
Head of Integrations
Clearsight Analytics

[Attachment: clearsight-compat-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: API contract / versioning alignment for Clearsight integration

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the matrix. I appreciate the urgency.

Short answer: we try to avoid breaking changes, and when unavoidable we support a staged deprecation with timelines and migration guidance. That said, we don't yet have a documented SLA-like "compatibility guarantee" across major versions and I can see why that would be important for a partner SDK.

I've looped in Jonas (platform integrations) and will pull Product into this thread (Vanessa) to draft a concrete proposal. Can you confirm which SDK consumer surface is most critical for you (embeddings response shape vs. metadata headers vs. streaming tokens)? That will help us scope the adapter work.

I'll aim to get a draft proposal by Friday close of business PST. If that's not feasible we can schedule a 30-minute sync for Monday.

—Marissa
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: api-change-proposal.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: API contract / versioning alignment for Clearsight integration

Marissa, Vanessa — quick technical notes from our spike and what we'd need to offer an "adapter + grace period" approach:

- Breaking surfaces we saw: embedding payload field name changes, removal of deprecated "meta_source" header, and two lesser-used pagination semantics for large embedding sets.
- Minimal viable adapter: server-side translation that accepts legacy payload names and maps them to the new schema (cost: additional CPU/memory per request but modest).
- Testing: we need partner test vectors and a staging key so we can run backwards-compat regression for at least two weeks prior to a soft-deprecation.

I recommend the following timeline:
A) 2 weeks to implement shim + internal QA,
B) 2 weeks of partner regression on staging (Clearsight provides sample payloads),
C) 8–12 week public grace period before hard removal.

If Product wants a different cadence we can adapt — this is our conservative plan.

Jonas
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alex Park <alex@clearsight.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: API contract / versioning alignment for Clearsight integration

Thanks Alex — and thanks team. I wanted to outline a short, concrete operational proposal so Clearsight can evaluate quickly: 

Proposal (high level):
1) Compatibility policy doc: Redwood will publish a "Serving API compatibility" page describing expected behavior, deprecation windows, and what constitutes a breaking change. Target publish date: 2027-09-15.
2) Adapter/shim support: For any breaking change we will provide a partner adapter that translates legacy payloads for a guaranteed 12-week grace period after public notice. We will maintain the shim for one additional quarter upon partner request (additional fee may apply).
3) Staging and testing: We'll provide a staging API key + a feature flag allowing partner traffic to exercise the shim. Partner must provide test payloads within 5 business days after initial signoff.
4) Escalation and SLA: For production-facing incidents related to the adapter, Redwood will provide a 4-hour response window during business hours and a 24-hour resolution target for critical regressions (per our support tier).

Next steps I propose: Marissa to consolidate into a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with dates and responsibilities; Jonas to produce an implementation estimate and PR for the shim; Alex to confirm which payloads to test and whether Clearsight wants the extended maintenance option.

I'll add a short timeline and publish it to the Drive link below once Marissa confirms.

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Product — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Clearsight integration compatibility (draft)

Alex — attaching a short MAP and timeline per Vanessa's outline. Summary of responsibilities and dates below. Please review and reply with any concerns.

MAP highlights:
- Publish compatibility doc by 2027-09-15 (Redwood: Product)
- Shim implementation PR opened by 2027-09-01 (Jonas / Platform) — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8342
- Partner testing window (Clearsight): 2027-09-04 to 2027-09-18 (2 weeks) — Clearsight provides payloads by 2027-09-01
- Public deprecation notice published 2027-09-20, hard removal earliest 2027-12-20 (12-week minimum public grace period)

Attachments: api-change-proposal.pdf (contains shim approach) and clearsight-compat-matrix.xlsx.

If that timeline works for you we'll treat this as agreed and I'll schedule a weekly 30-minute sync (starting 2027-09-06) to track progress.

—Marissa
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Park <alex@clearsight.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Priya Sinha <priya@clearsight.ai>
Date: 2027-08-26T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Clearsight integration compatibility (draft)

Marissa — thanks for the MAP and timeline. We appreciate the clear commitments. Two quick confirmations: 

1) We'll provide the test vectors by 2027-09-01 and confirm the exact fields we care most about (embeddings response shape + metadata headers).
2) Staging keys and the feature-flagged shim access: please let us know how to request those. We'll also confirm whether we want the extended maintenance option once we see the implementation cost.

This timeline looks good from our side — please consider this accepted pending the staging key details.

Alex
Head of Integrations
Clearsight Analytics
